hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate T[x,F,K] = F(x)^2*K(x). For the first member set x=p, F=V, K=G0 to obtain V(p)^2*G0(p), which is AC-equivalent to G0(p)*V(p)^2. For the second member set x=q, F=W, K=H0 to obtain W(q)^2*H0(q).
required_assumptions: Multiplication is commutative for symbolic factors
Function application is pointwise so F(x) is a scalar factor
hypotheses.rationale: The two summands are non-identical instances of the same parameterized square-linear monomial pattern; this structural similarity explains the LGG/AC family observation without invoking extra physical or latent geometric structure.
